assumptions: Immutable commit sources and M1 Git provenance describe the fixed patches; uncertain or unsupported operations are dependent on all others.
compatibility: Private experiment only. Existing 0.1.0-alpha Git replay evidence, advisory plan, CLI, schemas, producer and verifier remain exhaustive and unchanged.
domain: Two to four immutable base-to-commit Git patches and their declared dependency graph, with at most 24 admissible orders.
execution_contract: Isolated Git bare scratch and fresh index for every selected order; existing per-call Git budgets apply. No source mutation, ref promotion, project-code execution or execution authorization.
hypotheses: Some supported fixed-patch workloads allow fewer isolated Git replays while every adjacent-swap class agrees with the exhaustive tracked-tree-v1 baseline rerun by the existing verifier.
observation_contract: tracked-tree-v1 terminal Git tree IDs for complete schedules; incomplete schedules have no successful observation and raw traces remain in exhaustive evidence.

scenarios.given: Eligible operations on disjoint paths after a common prerequisite

obtained_evidence.limits: Local finite fixtures and repository validation only. The verifier repeats the exhaustive replay using the same implementation; this is not independent implementation diversity. Syntactic path disjointness does not prove semantic commutation, arbitrary-workload confluence, production speedup or execution safety. Founder review is internal; clean-room reproduction and independent external validation remain pending.
obtained_evidence.outcome: The focused suite passed all 24 tests, including the real-Git uncertain-path check; quick and PR repository profiles each passed 241 tests with one expected skip.
